senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;עָצַב2) trouble, toil; that which is acquired through toil.—Pl. עֲצָבִים.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:7">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <he>ועצביך</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 5:10">Prov. V, 10</cite>) <he>אין עֲצָבֶיךָ אלא בנים</he> (ed. Wil. <he>עֲצִיבָה וכ׳</he>) ‘thy toils’ means thy children (with ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>); <he>ע׳ זו יגיעת הארץ</he> ‘thy toils’ means painful labor in the field (with ref. to ib. 17).
